headline: JENNIE's 'Dracula' holds No. 3 on Billboard Hot 100
sub: P1Harmony's 'BLOW UP' debuts at No. 4 on the Billboard 200
caption:
'Dracula' by Tame Impala and BLACKPINK's JENNIE held at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 for a second straight week.

Boosted by short-form video buzz, the remix climbed back up the chart and stayed at its peak position. P1Harmony's new album 'BLOW UP' entered the Billboard 200 at No. 4, tying the group's best-ever ranking.

📌 Source: Billboard, Yonhap News (via Korean media)
